'''Alejandro C. Frery''' (born 21 February 1960) is an Argentine-born [[computational]] [[statistician]] and [[image processing]] expert. He is a full [[professor]] of Statistics and Data Science at the School of Mathematics and Statistics, [[Victoria University of Wellington]], New Zealand. His research focuses on statistical computing, stochastic modeling, and the analysis of [[synthetic aperture radar]] (SAR) and polarimetric SAR (PolSAR) imagery.

== Early life and education ==
Frery was born in Mendoza, Argentina, in 1960. He received a B.Sc. in Electronic and Electrical Engineering from [[Universidad de Mendoza]] in 1983. M.Sc. degree in [[Applied Mathematics]] ([[Statistics]]) from the [[Instituto de Matemática Pura e Aplicada]] in 1990. Ph.D. degree in Applied Computing from the [[Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais]], São José dos Campos, Brazil, in 1993.<ref>{{cite web |title=Alejandro Frery |url=https://openaccess.wgtn.ac.nz/authors/Alejandro_Frery/8937941 |website=openaccess.wgtn.ac.nz |access-date=21 July 2025}}</ref>

== Research and contributions ==
Frery's research intersects computational statistics and image processing, with significant work in:
* Statistical modeling of SAR/PolSAR data<ref>{{cite book |last1=Frery |first1=Alejandro C. |last2=Nascimento |first2=Abraão D. C. |title=Information-Theoretic Radar Signal Processing |chapter=Statistical Information Theory in SAR and PolSAR Image Analysis |date=17 December 2024 |pages=181–215 |doi=10.1002/9781394216956.ch7 |isbn=978-1-394-21692-5 }}</ref>
* Entropy and complexity measures in remote sensing<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Frery |first1=Alejandro C. |last2=Cintra |first2=Renato J. |last3=Nascimento |first3=Abraao D. C. |title=Entropy-Based Statistical Analysis of PolSAR Data |journal=IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing |date=June 2013 |volume=51 |issue=6 |pages=3733–3743 |doi=10.1109/TGRS.2012.2222029 |arxiv=1210.4154 |bibcode=2013ITGRS..51.3733F }}</ref>
* Information-theoretic image classification<ref>{{cite arXiv |last1=Frery |first1=A. C. |last2=Nascimento |first2=A. D. C. |last3=Cintra |first3=R. J. |title=Information Theory and Image Understanding: An Application to Polarimetric SAR Imagery |date=2014 |class=stat.ME |eprint=1402.1876 }}</ref>
* Image filtering and clustering in remote sensing application<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ferreira |first1=Jodavid A. |last2=Nascimento |first2=Abraão D. C. |last3=Frery |first3=Alejandro C. |title=PolSAR Models with Multimodal Intensities |journal=Remote Sensing |date=11 October 2022 |volume=14 |issue=20 |pages=5083 |doi=10.3390/rs14205083 |bibcode=2022RemS...14.5083F |doi-access=free }}</ref>

* [[IEEE Fellow]] (2025)<ref>{{cite web |title=IEEE Fellow Class of 2025 |url=https://www.ieee.org/content/dam/ieee-org/ieee/web/org/about/fellows/2025-fellows-class-announcement.pdf |website=www.ieee.org |publisher=[[IEEE]] |access-date=21 July 2025}}</ref>
